skill_name: Describe ways in which artificial intelligence could be used to help people.
workflow: Artificial intelligence can be used to help people in a number of ways. For example, AI can be used to develop smarter and more efficient healthcare systems, to automate certain tasks and make them more efficient, to improve safety and security, and to automate customer service tasks. AI can also be used to offer personalized recommendations and assistive technologies for people with disabilities.
